# Third-Party Notices

Vendored runtime assets are recorded in `manifest.toml`, with licenses under
`licenses/`. The browser deployment includes this notice, the manifest, and
the applicable license texts.

## Microsoft Fluent UI System Icons

Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft Corporation.

Unmodified 20px Regular SVGs from
[Microsoft Fluent UI System Icons](https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons)
are distributed under the MIT License. The pinned revision and individual source
paths and hashes are recorded in the manifest. The complete MIT License is in
`licenses/fluentui-system-icons.LICENSE.txt`; the upstream repository notice is
preserved in `licenses/fluentui-system-icons.NOTICE.txt`.

Masonry uses App Generic, Edit, Eraser, Folder, Brain Circuit, Color, and Image.
The view switch uses Board for masonry and Flowchart for graph.
Seed actions use Add, Subtract, and Arrow Counterclockwise. Model updates use Arrow Circle Up Sparkle.
Model picker filters use Eye for Show all and Eye Off for Show only an architecture.
CSS masks adapt their color to the current theme without modifying the SVGs.

## SugarSubstitute Media Wall Presentation

Copyright (C) 2026 Artificial Sweetener and contributors.

Gallery frame insets, caption padding, thumbnail geometry, wrapping vertical
navigation and active overflowing titles use
SugarSubstitute's presentation rules under GPL-3.0-or-later.
SugarCubes measures browser glyphs, fades text
edges during travel, respects reduced motion and releases animation with the
tile. Source revision, source hash and adapted paths are recorded in the manifest.
The complete license is in `licenses/sugarsubstitute.LICENSE.txt`.

Copyright (C) 2026 Artificial Sweetener and contributors.

The detector picker uses SugarSubstitute's seventeen unmodified PNG illustrations

## SugarSubstitute Model Catalog and Suggestions

Copyright (C) 2026 Artificial Sweetener and contributors.

The attached model picker placement follows the reference's available boundary,
preferred dimensions, side selection, and margin policy. SugarCubes applies this
policy to graph and masonry fields through one typed placement owner.

The OpenModelDB catalog values, parsing and cache behavior, reviewed upscaler
recommendations, registered-provider suggestion planning and acquisition,
provider-neutral suggestion values, exact-family CivitAI discovery and alternate
curated-upscaler offers, thumbnail-content safety policies, model artifact and
version-family eligibility rules, highlighted-model inline completion, and secure
CivitAI credential commands, Windows DPAPI storage, explicit empty-picker context
eligibility, reviewed discovery/acquisition coordination, exclusive portrait
suggestions, preview loading and unavailable states, bounded indeterminate progress arcs,
provider-source menus, and the contained credential prompt are adapted from
SugarSubstitute under GPL-3.0-or-later. SugarCubes uses strict typed application
and domain owners with its shared catalog, prepared assets, and verified transfer
pipeline. Acquisition preserves exact-size and hash verification, reuse of installed
bytes, and version-suffixed collision names. SugarCubes reserves hidden sidecars
and publishes with exclusive hard links to preserve other writers' files.
Automatic metadata lookup, explicit missing-model lookup, and CivitAI download
preferences retain their independent reference defaults and policy boundaries.
Provider freshness preserves exact file evidence, confirmed misses, thumbnail
selection policy identity, and prepared-asset availability. Valid local images
retain precedence over automatic provider images.
Exact provider matches retain separate metadata and ordered associations. Catalog
labels follow provider order, with CivitAI images available as fallback. Cache
maintenance preserves other providers and the source ownership of borrowed images.
SugarCubes retains complete metadata activity leases through asynchronous provider
work and physical publication. Cancelled requests drain their blocking writers;
exclusive maintenance waits for committed catalog and freshness decisions.
CivitAI cache settings expose record and image usage, Clear thumbnails, Clear
metadata, and Refresh. Provider-specific decisions and retry ownership keep these
operations separate from user choices, local images, and other provider records.
Prepared image source and variant ownership follows the reference's separate
asset store. SugarCubes serializes publication with collection and retains every
persisted user, local, and provider owner, including older image references.
Unclassified legacy references remain protected. Cache usage counts shared
physical WebP bytes once for each origin.
The source revision, source paths and hashes, and adapted module paths
are recorded in the manifest. The complete license is in
`licenses/sugarsubstitute.LICENSE.txt`.
